_metadata.criterion: per-pseudopotential: the entry records which metric decided it (`criterion`: nu or epsilon, with `tolerance` and `reference_point`). The SSSP control protocol uses nu <= 0.2 %.
_metadata.note: O cutoffs are fixed to the recommended values of O_ONCV_PBE-1.0; the effective cutoff of a mixed U/O cell is the maximum over its elements.
